_meta.data_channel: WebSearch snippets only - direct HTTP egress blocked in this environment
_meta.confidence_scale: high = stated explicitly by a source; med = derived/consistent across sources; low = estimated, MUST be overwritten with real data

league_baseline._source: Serie A 2025-26 season summary (380 matches, 922 goals, 2.43/match)

season_2526._anchor: CONFIRMED: 3rd place, CL qualification, 61 pts after 34 games (19W-4D-11L, 48 GF, 29 GA), 3 pts behind Napoli. Final-day 2-0 win vs Verona. Totals for the last 4 games are extrapolated.

recent_split._anchor: CONFIRMED: after 19 matchdays Roma had 22 GF / 12 GA and led the table. Italian coverage of the girone di ritorno is explicit that the defence fell apart ('la difesa balla, i punti non arrivano') and the title challenge collapsed. Second half derived by subtraction from the season totals.
recent_split._note: 1.16 GF and 0.63 GA per game in the first half vs 1.68 GF and 1.11 GA in the second. The season aggregate hides a real regime change - the most recent 19 games are a better guide to the current side than the full 38.

squad_delta_2627._note: attack: + = better. defense: - = fewer goals conceded. Castro adds a real No.9 profile behind Malen; Molina upgrades RWB; Koulierakis replaces churn. Gasperini year 2 = system already installed. Modest net positive.

season_2526._anchor: CONFIRMED: 15th place; 13 pts in the andata and 29 in the ritorno (=42). Top league scorer Moise Kean with only 8 goals (Gudmundsson 10 in all comps) => genuinely weak attack. Biggest win 5-1 vs Udinese (H). Biggest loss 0-4 at Roma. Conference League QF, Coppa Italia R16. Pioli sacked 04/11/2025, Vanoli in from 07/11/2025.
season_2526._tension: 15th place and 42 points do not sit comfortably together - 42 pts is normally around 12th. Either the table was unusually compressed or one of the two figures comes from a partial-season snapshot. Both are recorded here as found; the split below is what actually drives the model, and it is the better-sourced of the two.

recent_split._anchor: CONFIRMED: 29 points in the girone di ritorno, +16 on the andata, 7th in the return-round table ahead of Milan and Bologna. From 07/02/2026 onward: 18 points in 9 games, a Champions-League pace bettered only by Inter and Napoli. Goal splits are DERIVED from the points splits, not sourced.
recent_split._note: This is the single most important find of the run. Rating Fiorentina off the 38-game aggregate treats them as a relegation-scrap side; over the last 19 games they played like a European contender. But the coach who produced that form (Vanoli) is gone and Grosso is in, so the form is only partly transferable - hence manager_continuity=false, which discounts the recency weight in ratings.py.

manager.name: Fabio Grosso
manager._note: Vanoli sacked at end of 2025/26. Fabio Paratici arrived as sporting director.

squad_delta_2627._note: Priced DOWN from +0.10/-0.10 once the ritorno form was found: that improvement is now carried by recent_split, and leaving it here as well would double-count it. What remains is the transfer window alone - Dragusin+Viery rebuild the centre-backs, Jimenez/Atta/Oulai add athleticism, Kean+Gudmundsson retained.

head_to_head._note: H2H is used only as a weak prior nudge (see ratings.py H2H_WEIGHT). Long-run H2H mostly encodes team quality already captured elsewhere; double-counting it is a classic overfit.

market._note: Sharpest single input available. Overround ~4.5%. Used as a Bayesian anchor via log-opinion pooling, NOT as ground truth.

context_flags._note: Late-August 20:45 kickoff in Rome: hot, humid. Historically depresses tempo and total goals slightly. Modelled as GOALS_HEAT_FACTOR.

preseason_2627._model_note: Asimmetria di preparazione reale e documentata, ma NON inserita come parametro nel modello: non ho una stima difendibile di quanto valga in gol una partita ufficiale di vantaggio contro una squadra di Serie B. E' registrata qui perche influenzi la lettura del risultato, non i numeri.
